claim_conflicts.note: bytes proved by two admitted objects; merge them into one unit (lane MERGE) before a real LINK

lanes.CODE_GAP: code bytes outside every known function extent (alignment, tails, unknown entries)
lanes.RUNTIME_CODE: library/runtime code not yet matched to a complete historical member
lanes.DATA: initialized data not yet owned by an admitted object
lanes.LINK: NE header, tables, relocation tables and file padding (authentic LINK + DEF)
lanes.RESOURCES: resource table and resource bytes not proved by the RC payload admission
lanes.MERGE: bytes claimed by two admitted objects; combine them in one unit (not raw, but blocks a real link)
